segments.name: Gabon
segments.description: Operates the offshore Etame Marin block and exploration licenses in Gabon, producing crude oil under production sharing contracts.
segments.evidence: We own a 58.8% working interest in the Etame Marin block and we are the designated operator on behalf of the Etame Consortium.

segments.name: Egypt
segments.description: Produces crude oil from concessions in Egypt's Eastern and Western Deserts under production sharing contracts with the Egyptian government.
segments.evidence: In Egypt, our interests are spread across two regions: the Eastern Desert, which contains the Merged Concession, and the Western Desert, which contains the South Ghazalat concession.

segments.name: Cote d'Ivoire
segments.description: Holds non-operated and operated interests in deepwater oil blocks offshore Cote d'Ivoire, producing crude oil via an FPSO.
segments.evidence: The Company holds a 27.4% non-operated working interest (30.4% paying interest) in CI-40 in the deepwater producing Baobab field in Block CI-40, offshore Cote d'Ivoire in West Africa.

segments.name: Equatorial Guinea
segments.description: Owns an operated interest in undeveloped Block P offshore Equatorial Guinea, advancing the Venus field development plan.
segments.evidence: We currently own a 60% working interest in an undeveloped portion of Block P offshore Equatorial Guinea where we are the designated operator.

segments.name: Canada
segments.description: Produced crude oil, natural gas and NGLs from properties in Harmattan, Alberta, divested in the Canada Asset Divestment.
segments.evidence: Prior to the Canada Asset Divestment, we owned production and working interests in Cardium light oil and Mannville liquids-rich gas assets in Harmattan, which is a core play in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basis, and is located approximately 80 kilometers north of Calgary, Alberta.

changes.text: In 2026, the company completed the Canada Asset Divestment, exiting its Canadian oil and gas operations.
changes.evidence: The Canada Asset Divestment represents the Company's complete exit of its Canadian oil and gas operations.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired Svenska, adding production in Cote d'Ivoire.
changes.evidence: For Cote d'Ivoire, reflects sales from April 30, 2024 through December 31, 2024 related to the Svenska Acquisition.
